description: Every language catalog in Cyber Library with item counts and the corpus generation date. When to use: first call in any session - it tells you which languages exist and how large each is, so you can pick a language before fetching a shard. Do not use: to list actual books (call cyberlibrary_language_shard) or to read a book (call cyberlibrary_get_markdown / cyberlibrary_get_chapter). Returns: {generated_at, total_items, readable_items, languages[]} where each language entry carries {lang, total_items, url|pages}.
name: cyberlibrary_catalog_index
